# NPM Configuration File
# This file configures npm behavior for the smart-village-app/sva-studio project

# provenance: Enables npm provenance statements during package publishing
# When set to true, npm will generate and publish provenance attestations that cryptographically

# Requires npm 9.5.0 or higher and a supported CI/CD environment.
provenance=true

cleanupUnusedCatalogs: true
injectWorkspacePackages: true
